evidence_packet.evidence_text: Romiley Beloved gran fell from window of Stockport care home 'having already tried to climb through it', inquest told Her family described it as a 'preventable tragedy' News Stephen Topping Senior reporter 19:10, 16 Sep 2026 View 3 Images Maureen O'Ca A much-loved grandma died after falling through her upstairs bedroom window at a Stockport care home, an inquest has heard. Maureen O'Callaghan had moved to Berrycroft Manor, in Romiley , to benefit from '24-hour care' at a cost of '£1,600 a week', her family told Stockport Coron But the inquest heard how the 78-year-old, who had dementia, 'went downhill' throughout her time at the home in 2025.
